content.title: Scottie Scheffler: Meet the athlete
content.text: Scottie Scheffler hits the ball in the fairway of the eighteenth hole during the playoff round of the Travelers Championship golf tournament at TPC River Highlands.Gregory Fisher-USA TODAY Sports In just a few short years on the PGA Tour, Scottie Scheffler has established himself as one of the sport's major players. Since his first win in 2022, Scheffler has been on a meteoric rise, winning at a rate that hasn't been seen in years, and only ever by the game's biggest stars. Now, in the midst of a historic season, Scheffler is preparing to make his Olympic debut and shoot for Gold in Paris. Get to know Scheffler as he gets ready for the Games. Athlete bio How old is Scottie Scheffler? Scottie Scheffler is 28 years old and was born on June 21, 1996. How tall is Scottie Scheffler? Scottie Scheffler is 6-foot-3. Where is Scottie Scheffler from? Scottie Scheffler is from Ridgewood, New Jersey. When he was six, his family moved to Dallas, Texas, which is where he spent most of his childhood. When did Scottie Scheffler start golfing? Scottie Scheffler started swinging a set of plastic golf clubs his parents had given him at just three years old. When he was six years old his family moved to Dallas and he joined the Royal Oaks Country Club, where he began working with legendary coach Randy Smith. Scheffler’s parents had to borrow money in order to secure a place at the club so he could practice his golf. Who are Scottie Scheffler’s parents? Scottie Scheffler’s parents are Scott and Diane Scheffler. His mother Diane works as a COO at a law firm in Dallas, while his father Scott is a stay-at-home dad. Both parents worked to encourage Scheffler’s love for golf at a young age, gifting him his first set of clubs at three and working to bring him to tournaments throughout his childhood. Who are Scottie Scheffler’s siblings? Scottie Scheffler has three sisters: Callie, Sara and Mollie. All the Scheffler siblings played golf at some point in their lives, while Callie played golf at Texas A&M. She also caddied for Scheffler when he competed as an amateur at the 2016 U.S. Open. Is Scottie Scheffler married? Scottie Scheffler is married to his high school girlfriend Meredith Scudder, and the couple have one son together. What is Scottie Scheffler’s net worth? Scottie Scheffler’s net worth is estimated to be about $50 million, though some reports suggest it could be anywhere up to $90 million. USA
